description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {R}{G}{W}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
